sql: SELECT T1.title FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Keyword AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T2.keyword = 'laundering money'
SELECT SUM(T2.votes) FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Vote AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.title = 'Cherished'

SELECT T2.role FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Credit AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id INNER JOIN Person AS T3 ON T3.person_id = T2.person_id WHERE T1.title = 'Cherished' AND T3.name = 'Park Dietz' AND T2.credited = 'true'
SELECT T1.credited FROM Credit AS T1 INNER JOIN Person AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id WHERE T1.episode_id = 'tt0629204' AND T2.name = 'Anthony Azzara'
SELECT COUNT(T2.role) FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Credit AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.series = 'Law and Order' AND T1.season = 9 AND T1.episode = 17 AND T2.credited = 'true'
SELECT T1.role FROM Credit AS T1 INNER JOIN Person AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id WHERE T2.name = 'Joseph Blair'
SELECT air_date FROM Episode ORDER BY votes DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.title = 'Refuge: Part 1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.title = 'Shield' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Keyword AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id
SELECT T2.keyword FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Keyword AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.title = 'Shield'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.episode_id), CAST(COUNT(T2.person_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.episode_id) FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Credit AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.series = 'Law and Order' AND T1.season = 9 AND T2.category = 'Cast'

SELECT keyword FROM Keyword WHERE episode_id = (SELECT T1.episode_id FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Keyword AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id GROUP BY T1.episode_id ORDER BY T1.votes DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1)

SELECT T1.organization FROM Award AS T1 INNER JOIN Person AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id WHERE T2.name = 'Constantine Makris' AND T1.result = 'Winner' GROUP BY T1.organization ORDER BY COUNT(T1.award_id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(T2.person_id) FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Credit AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.title = 'Admissions' AND T2.credited = ''
SELECT T2.title FROM Credit AS T1 INNER JOIN Episode AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.category = 'Art Department' GROUP BY T2.episode_id ORDER BY COUNT(T1.person_id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(T1.role) FROM Credit AS T1 INNER JOIN Person AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id WHERE T2.name = 'Julia Roberts'

SELECT DISTINCT T2.title FROM Award AS T1 INNER JOIN Episode AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.award_category = 'Primetime Emmy' AND T1.series = 'Law and Order' AND T1.result = 'Nominee'
SELECT birth_place, birth_region FROM Person WHERE birth_name = 'Rene Chenevert Balcer'
